review: Library + Library ▸ Notes final Sr-Designer/HCI review
head: 2d34cbf80d
severity_policy: Final severity = the live re-repro verdict unless triage surfaced an ADR/owner ruling or a harm the repro did not weigh, or the rubric defines the class (data loss/crash = P0).

findings.title: Ctrl+Q quits without flushing: unsaved note text is lost, and a new note becomes an empty 'Untitled' row
findings.fix: Add LibraryScreen.confirm_quit() that awaits flush_pending_work() (library_screen.py:11109). On a veto or failure, ask 'Quit and discard unsaved changes to "<title>"? Keep editing · Discard and quit', with Keep editing focused. prepare_for_quit() runs the blank-note GC. Add a ~10 s max-wait to the 2 s autosave debounce. Arch test: any Screen that defines flush_pending_work must define confirm_quit.
findings.severity_note: The verifier widened the scope: typing a character every 1.2 s never saves, so Ctrl+Q loses everything typed since the last pause.

findings.title: One ordinary edit to a synced note wedges the whole sync root (postcondition_failed); Recovery loops on 'RuntimeError' while Notes says 'Saved' / 'Sync managed · Ready'
findings.fix: In _classify, compare file bytes with serialize(note.content, profile) (notes_sync_executor.py:5384; also :3522 and :5167). Recovery then self-heals roots that are already stuck. Add postcondition_failed to _CHECK_FAILURE_ROW with plain copy and a real next action. While an op is incomplete, the tree row, list scope and editor location line read 'Needs attention', not 'Ready'/'Saved'.
findings.severity_note: Trigger: Ctrl+End, then type without Enter on a file that ends in a newline. Reproduced 2/2, with a control run.

findings.title: Deleting a synced note leaves the root at '✓ Up to date' while the file still exists
findings.fix: Within 32633, raise priority and land delete_note/restore_note first: call note_changed(note_id), as note_session_port.py:190 does. Until all 17 write paths signal, render '✓ Up to date as of HH:MM'. The delete confirm for a synced note says the file stays on disk.
findings.severity_note: This is a documented limitation (notes.md:802-822), but the row still states something false about sync. Critique #4's N1 was rated P0 for the same reason.

findings.title: At ≥120 columns the Notes tree cannot scroll: notes, 'Load more notes' and 'Recently deleted' below the fold are unreachable, and focus moves onto rows that are never shown
findings.fix: Give the wide #library-notes-list 'height:1fr; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden' (css/features/_library_panels.tcss:543-548) and regenerate the bundle with css/build_css.py. Pilot test at 120x36 and 160x45: max_scroll_y > 0, and the 30th focused row is visible.
findings.severity_note: j3 rated it P0. P1 because the filter is a (poor) workaround.

findings.title: Note editor header overflows from 120 to ~200 cols: Save, 'Use in Console' and 'Discard new note' are clipped or missing, save state is a 1-column strip, Tab/F6 land on hidden controls
findings.fix: Choose the header shape from the editor pane's own width, not the 120-col shell breakpoint. Below ~70 pane cols use two rows: [Edit · Preview · Info] and [Save · Use in Console · Discard new note]. Drop the 61-cell min-width. The status gets its own row, or moves to the chrome strip (32513/32514). Never truncate 'Use in Console'. F6 skips clipped targets.
findings.severity_note: 120 cols is the worst width: at 119 cols the compact header fits everything.

findings.title: Opening any modal (F1, Move note, command palette) cancels the pending autosave and never re-arms it; the status keeps promising automatic save
findings.fix: In on_screen_resume, call _schedule_library_note_autosave() when the note session is dirty. Show 'changes save automatically' only while a save is actually scheduled.
findings.severity_note: j1 rated it P0. The resulting loss belongs to N-01.

findings.title: An autosave validation veto (trailing space in title, duplicate keyword) moves focus mid-typing, so the next words land in the wrong field
findings.fix: Pass an explicit/autosave flag into _apply_library_note_save_outcome (library_notes_controller.py:3945). On an autosave veto, mark the field inline and never move focus or switch to Info. On blur, strip title edge whitespace and dedupe keywords as a visible draft edit (ADR-027-compatible). While a veto shows, drop the 'save automatically' suffix.

findings.title: Typed [[wikilinks]] are dead text and are not counted as backlinks; Preview sends note:// links to the OS URL handler
findings.fix: Ship first: Preview Markdown with open_links=False plus a LinkClicked handler, so note:// opens in the app (library_notes_canvas.py:2909). Then: a '[[' title picker that inserts the stored form, 'Copy link to this note' in Info, and a note_links edge for a bare [[Title]] that resolves to exactly one note (within the task-32263 ruling).
findings.severity_note: Triage argued P2 (linking was never built). Kept at P1: the guide promises hand-typed links (notes.md:463), no screen shows the UUID they need, and j1 gave up on the task.

findings.title: Notes filter matches only whole-word phrases in title and body: no prefix, word order matters, keywords are not searchable
findings.fix: At note_folder_repository.py:808, use and_then_prefix (AND the tokens, prefix-match the last); treat input as a phrase only when it is quoted. UNION keyword matches through note_keywords. The zero-result copy names what is searched. Plan-pin any new index (CLAUDE.md gotcha 1).

findings.title: The inline delete confirm is clipped inside Info: Cancel and Delete are pressed blind
findings.fix: Add the base rule '#library-note-delete-confirmation { height:auto }' (it is currently a 1fr Vertical with overflow hidden). Show the block, then call_after_refresh(scroll_visible), then focus Cancel. Pilot test at 120x36 and 80x24.
findings.severity_note: Regression of TASK-32268 and TASK-32642. The cause depends on pane height, not width.

findings.title: Note and prompt Export silently overwrite an existing file outside Chatbook (title-derived name, starting at ~)
findings.fix: Add an overwrite confirm at the shared FileSave seam ('Replace "x.md" in ~/exp? Cancel · Replace', Cancel focused) for the note, prompt, artifact and collections exports. Write via a temp file plus os.replace. Remember the last export directory. Toast the full path.
findings.severity_note: Escalated to P0: unrecoverable loss of a user file, with a 'success' toast. A recurring title collides by default.

findings.title: Cancelling a note export is reported as 'Export failed', and focus lands on Delete
findings.fix: Treat selected_path None as cancellation: no failure copy and one quiet signal. After any outcome, refocus the button that started the operation. transfer_running disables the focused button, so focus currently jumps to Delete, and that also happens after a successful export or a Copy.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: Delete still has a confirm with Cancel focused.

findings.title: Arriving through Create (palette 'New Note' or rail New note) shows the Notes tree without its folders, and Add to folder lists nothing
findings.fix: In _create_library_note, request the root (None,'folders') branch when it is missing, before the locate. Never paint label-less rows: show 'Loading folders…'. Regression test: palette Create > Blank > Esc, then assert folders are present and the Add-to-folder choices are not empty.

findings.title: Notes select mode can only Export; 'Select all N shown' miscounts; selecting costs two keys per row (Space does nothing)
findings.fix: Compute the Select-all label from the rendered ids ('Select all 20 loaded'). Space toggles the focused row (copy Media's priority binding). Add an 'Actions…' chooser: Move to folder, Add/Remove keyword, Delete with one undo receipt.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: Select all still selects the right set, and single-note move and tag work.

findings.title: Sync review rows for files deleted or renamed can never be resolved, and they block every safe change in the root
findings.fix: Let Apply reviewed apply the safe subset (_apply_blocker; runtime _blocked_plan_status). Show the blocker as visible text, not a hover-only tooltip. Enable 'Disconnect item'. Then build 'Restore missing side' and 'Delete counterpart' (move to trash, never unlink), and treat a rename as a move.

findings.title: One non-UTF-8 or mixed-newline file blocks the whole sync folder with 'Check failed — NotesSyncRootRefused'
findings.fix: Record per-file gate refusals as skip rows that name the file, instead of raising for the whole root (notes_sync_runtime.py:930-946). Keep the _CHECK_FAILURE_ROW and _CHECK_REFUSAL_COPY key sets equal, pinned by a test.

findings.title: 'Add from files…' sticks on a stale lasting-sync phase (old receipt, configure form or a blank page), hiding Import once until restart
findings.fix: Add begin_add_from_files(), which resets the phase to 'choose' unless a check or activation is running. abandon_setup ends in 'choose'. The canvas renders the chooser for any phase it does not handle. The receipt bar gets 'Manage sync folders'.
findings.severity_note: Wider than reported: just opening Keep synced and pressing ‹ Notes triggers it.

findings.title: Every synced folder is titled 'Sync folder (name unavailable before cutover)'; roots and receipts cannot be told apart
findings.fix: Carry display_name in NotesSyncRootRuntimeSnapshot and use it as the row title. Fall back to 'Synced folder N', never 'cutover'. Prefix each receipt with its root name. Order rows by creation, not by uuid.
findings.severity_note: The verifier paused the second-created root while it was listed first, because rows are ordered by random uuid.

findings.title: Sync Receipts says 'No writes yet.' when the history could not be read
findings.fix: Count failed write_receipts reads and show 'Couldn't read sync history for N folder(s) · Retry'. Use the empty copy only when every read succeeds. Iterate _all_roots, not just one page. Refresh when the runtime turns active.
findings.severity_note: Confirmed live by fault injection, but it is not naturally reachable on small or medium roots, and reopening clears it.

findings.title: Exported note front matter is invalid YAML for ordinary titles (':', '*', a leading quote; '#' silently becomes null)
findings.fix: Add one render_front_matter() helper using yaml.safe_dump (lazy import) for chatbook_creator.py:1463 and library_notes_state.py:914. Emit tags as lists. Round-trip test through yaml.safe_load and the app's own _split_frontmatter.

findings.title: No fast path from a filter query to a note, and no multi-hop note history
findings.fix: Enter on an unchanged filter opens the first result; Down in the filter focuses the first row. Following a backlink shows a one-level '‹ <origin note>' back cue. Defer an 'Open note…' palette provider. Do not use the 'o' key (it already means open evidence).
findings.severity_note: A one-hop return already costs only Esc+Enter.

findings.title: Arrow keys skip folder rows, and there is no expand/collapse key in the Notes tree
findings.fix: Add 'library-notes-folder-row' and 'library-notes-tree-pager' to _LIBRARY_LIST_ROW_CLASSES (screen_constants.py:434). On a focused folder row, Right expands and Left collapses or jumps to the parent.

findings.title: Folder pickers list only folders whose branches were loaded in this visit; nested targets are missing on a fresh visit
findings.fix: Make the picker a type-to-filter list over all active folders (20 at a time, exact total). Titles name the item: 'Move "<title>" to…'.

findings.title: 'Move note' fails intermittently with a false 'That folder changed elsewhere — refresh and try aga…', with no Refresh control
findings.fix: Diagnose the spurious FolderConflictError on the move path. Hypothesis: SQLite BUSY/LOCKED on a borrowed stale transaction is mapped to 'conflict'. Give conflict reasons their own copy plus a real Refresh button. Clear the selection after a delete. Wrap the notice instead of truncating it.
findings.severity_note: The verifier rated it P1 (4 of 7 moves failed and nothing was written). Kept at P2 because 'Add to folder' worked 4/4 as a workaround. The failure is not specific to Unfiled notes.

findings.title: The leave-veto toast names a 'Discard new note' button that is never shown, and blames the title for every veto
findings.fix: Build the toast from save_outcome.veto (field and reason). Mention 'Discard new note' only while that button is visible, which is effectively never at veto time.

findings.title: Info 'Linked from' never resolves on a new note, or shows the previous note's backlinks
findings.fix: Add one shared _reset_library_note_facts() used on create as well as on open. A fresh note sets backlinks=() and 'ready', and resets its location.

findings.title: 'View 10 imported notes' lands on the list with the import folder collapsed
findings.fix: Locate the first imported note with _locate_library_notes_tree_target(focus=True). Do this after the N-28 fix.

findings.title: Moving a folder into a collapsed folder hides the target's own notes until it is collapsed and re-expanded
findings.fix: The locator loads the placements slice for every folder it newly expands, through a shared _ensure_library_notes_folder_slices().

findings.title: Notes 'Recently deleted' can never delete permanently, and holds only the newest 20 with no pager
findings.fix: Add 'Delete forever' (key x; ADR-055 Pattern B confirm naming the title), backed by a hard-delete seam that purges FTS, keywords, memberships, versions and sync_log. Refuse, or warn, for synced notes. Add an ADR-067 pager.
findings.severity_note: Revisits the task-32144 ruling.

findings.title: The Notes sort chooser opens with focus left in the Filter field
findings.fix: In handle_library_notes_sort, use then= to focus the active '✓' choice (_focus_library_choice_strip_active). Return focus to #library-notes-sort on close.

findings.title: Notes text fields never show the 'typing in field' footer state, and Esc in the filter discards the unsubmitted draft
findings.fix: Apply the shared 'typing in field / after esc:' footer grammar to the Notes tiers. Esc in the filter keeps the draft.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the claimed collision between chips does not render; the harm is a missing cue plus a lost draft.

findings.title: F6 in the note body selects the current line instead of moving to the next pane
findings.fix: Add a priority Binding('f6','focus_next_workbench_pane') to LibraryScreen.BINDINGS beside shift+f6 (library_screen.py:1022). Not app-level: ADR-031 keeps the global F6 non-priority.

findings.title: Ctrl+S saves only in Skills; the Notes save action is dead code; Prompts and Folder files have no save key
findings.fix: Converge on ADR-031: remove the Skills ctrl+s (library_screen.py:1047) and the dead action_library_notes_save. Or amend ADR-031 for an editor-scoped Ctrl+S bound in all four editors at once (owner question Q2).
findings.severity_note: Notes having no Ctrl+S is deliberate (ADR-031 r2, pinned by tests); Skills is the outlier.

findings.title: Escape cancels a running import while ‹ Notes leaves it running; every exit drops staged sync-review choices
findings.fix: Esc during an import behaves like ‹ Notes, and the import continues. Keep staged review choices until the observation changes. Give the back cue an origin ('‹ Sync folders'). Clear the stale 'Choice staged' line.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the footer says 'esc cancel', and nothing is lost on disk.

findings.title: Sync comparison shows raw nanosecond and ISO timestamps, exception class names and stale status lines
findings.fix: Show local 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' on both sides and mark the newer one. Replace the type-name fallback with a plain sentence plus a next action. Gate the history-disabled line on the root's activation state.

findings.title: Folder files' Session Git shows status but never a diff, even at Confirm commit
findings.fix: Add a read-only 'View diff' per row (git diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv, --cached for staged), bounded with the conflict-compare limits. Add a staged-diff disclosure to Review commit.

findings.title: Folder files with no folder linked is 61–90% blank, the rail jumps 3–4 rows, and at 120x36 the rail is not rendered at all
findings.fix: Keep the work pane mounted before a folder is linked, with a centred 'No folder linked · Choose folder…' empty state. Move the authority and root rows into the work column so the rail stays put. Hide 'Review recovered pairing…' until a pairing exists.
findings.severity_note: Triage rated P3 (the rail-before-link layout is owner-ruled). Kept P2 because the verifier found no rail at all at 120x36.

findings.title: Media list 'Export…' freezes the whole app (no input, no repaint, Ctrl+Q dead)
findings.fix: Make LibraryMediaCanvas's export forwarder synchronous and hand off via self.screen.call_later, or route #library-media-export on the screen like its siblings (library_screen.py:29708). Guard _apply_library_open_item_surface against awaiting recompose from a descendant. Pilot test: press export, then Escape, and the app responds.
findings.severity_note: Self-removal deadlock, proven with a minimal Textual repro. Introduced by 480eadbba8.

findings.title: Analysis always says 'No analysis provider is configured', even when [analysis_defaults] names a ready provider
findings.fix: Add 'analysis_defaults': copy.deepcopy(toml_config_data.get('analysis_defaults', {})) to load_settings (config.py ~2605). Add a guard test that every table read through app_config.get exists. Fix the false remedy 'Settings ▸ Providers & Models' (task-28018).
findings.severity_note: Affects every user: the app's own bootstrap writes the section, and load_settings drops it.

findings.title: Opening an item by link leaves the list selection on row 1, so Read later, trash and Edit metadata act on a different document
findings.fix: Canonicalise record_id to 'local:media:N' in the media branch of _open_library_item_by_id (library_screen.py:34798). Reader-scoped actions act on reader_session.loaded_id. The trash confirm names the item.
findings.severity_note: The Search 'Open' half did not reproduce. The verifier found that Edit metadata Save also targets the wrong row.

findings.title: Export bundles silently drop keywords for media, notes and conversations
findings.fix: Creator: fetch keywords with fetch_keywords_for_media_batch, get_keywords_for_notes_batch and get_keywords_for_conversations, and write them into metadata and ContentItem.tags. Importer: re-link note and conversation keywords (the ADR-057 precedent). Add a round-trip test per type.

findings.title: Import rejects '~/' paths as a 'dangerous pattern', then says 'Can't find that path' for a file that exists (and a fast Enter imports anyway)
findings.fix: Expand '~' at the preflight boundary (ingest_preflight.py:421). The submit path already expands it. Enter waits for the current preflight. Show one plain message per failure.

findings.title: RAG Answer ignores the Console provider and model, calls OpenAI's handler default (gpt-5.6-terra), and names the model only after the paid call
findings.fix: Resolve provider and model from [chat_defaults] the way briefings do (resolve_remembered_provider_model), and pass the model through. The pre-run line reads 'To OpenAI · gpt-4.1-mini: question + evidence'. Apply the same fix to the scheduled-automation path.
findings.severity_note: Wider than reported: with Console set to Anthropic, RAG still billed OpenAI.

findings.title: 'Add analysis' puts focus on the first Items row, so typed text is lost and 'i' or 's' fire list commands
findings.fix: Call _after_library_media_viewer_sync('#library-media-analysis-edit-text'), or '#library-media-edit-title' for Edit metadata. Cancel and Save return focus to the button that opened the form.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: trash, Console and read-later are gated off while editing, and clicking into the box works.

findings.title: Escape in the analysis or metadata editor discards typed text without asking
findings.fix: Apply ADR-055 Pattern D: record a baseline when the form opens. A dirty Esc keeps the form, and the footer reads 'esc save or discard first'. While dirty, Cancel becomes 'Discard changes'. Same for the metadata form.

findings.title: When a filter hides the loaded conversation, 'c' resumes it, Use as source links it and then refuses, and Archive does nothing
findings.fix: When a settled filter drops the loaded conversation, load the first match (Media's filter_select_first), or label the Reader 'Not in current results' and disable c, Resume, Use as source and Archive. Write the workspace link only after staging succeeds.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the outcomes are visible or undoable, and clicking the row works around it. Archive is dead, not wrong-target.

findings.title: 'Try report demo' creates a persistent live-RSS watchlist with a daily paid brief and hourly fetches, disclosed only afterwards
findings.fix: Relabel it 'Set up a daily brief…' and add an inline confirm naming the feeds, the 24 h brief, hourly source checks, the provider and model, and how to remove it. Put the CTA under the empty-state sentence. Share the copy with artifacts_screen.py (the ADR-079 consequence copy was dropped in the port).

findings.title: The built-in skill 'Enabled' switch shows OFF as an empty box (1.22:1) with no text change
findings.fix: Replace the Switch with a Button labelled with library_toggle_label: 'Enabled: ✓ on ⇄ off'. Drop the ✓ on list rows marked Disabled.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the list row reads '· Disabled' at widths of 64 or more.

findings.title: At 64–95 columns, Media and Skills open with the list collapsed beside an empty Reader
findings.fix: Remove the <64 cap on list_first_when_empty in resolve_adaptive_reader_layout. Set the flag on the Skills, Conversations and Collections profiles. Delete Skills' 82-col items floor. Re-pin the 80x24 tests.
findings.severity_note: Conversations does auto-load a transcript; only Media and Skills are empty. Recovery is one click or Tab Tab Enter.

findings.title: Search mode returns 'No evidence matched' for a plain question the documents answer; the rail box silently switches the mode to Search
findings.fix: For question-shaped queries, use zero-result copy that says Search matches every word, with an 'Ask as RAG Answer' button that does not auto-run. Use a placeholder per mode. When the rail forces Search, say so on the run's status line.

findings.title: In-document Find counts lines, not matches, and marks nothing in the default Rendered view
findings.fix: Return (line, col) per occurrence. Highlight and step through every occurrence. While a query is active, show Raw with the note 'Showing raw text while Find is active'.

findings.title: Reader Find needs Enter and keeps showing the previous query's count and marks
findings.fix: Add an Input.Changed handler: while the input differs from the submitted query, the status reads 'Enter to find' and Prev/Next are dimmed.

findings.title: Returning to Media via the rail shows a row marked 'loaded' beside an empty Reader
findings.fix: Rebuild reader_session in the rail-switch reset (library_screen.py:22391) after capturing reading progress.
findings.severity_note: Happens only when the item was the first row. The 'c/t act on it' claim was not supported.

findings.title: 'Select evidence' remounts the cards, so focus lands on a Sources checkbox and the panel jumps to the top
findings.fix: Update the selection label and class in place, or capture and restore the focus id and scroll offset for any focused descendant of a card.
findings.severity_note: The next Enter toggles a source and silently narrows the scope.

findings.title: The Export canvas promises 'copies full media files into the zip' but writes text only; a same-day export overwrites by default; the size is never reported
findings.fix: Remove the inert quality chooser and show one fixed line: 'Text and metadata only — original media files are not included'. Add a README that maps media_<id>.txt to titles (keep the names; the importer relies on them). The default name gets ' (2)' when it already exists. The receipt shows count and size.
findings.severity_note: Raised to P1: a backup screen claims originals are included. A side finding, case-colliding note titles silently dropped from the zip, should be filed separately.

findings.title: Media selection is cleared by any page turn, and there is no bulk keyword action
findings.fix: Amend ADR-067 to give Media the Prompts cross-page basket ('N selected · M on this page'). Add 'Keywords…' to the select toolbar, under the overflow at <110 cols.

findings.title: Imports are titled by filename stem; PDF Title/Author, HTML <title> and Markdown H1 are ignored
findings.fix: Stop pre-filling the title with file_path.stem (local_file_ingestion.py:1066). Read result['metadata'] for title and author (:1670). Use <title>/og:title/h1 for HTML and front matter or the first H1 for Markdown, with the stem last.

findings.title: Local HTML import keeps site navigation, duplicates the heading and flattens tables into RAG chunks
findings.fix: Use shared trafilatura extraction (include_tables=True, markdown) for both local and URL HTML. The BeautifulSoup fallback strips head, nav and footer, and joins table cells with ' | '.

findings.title: Reader 'Open original' and 'Open manager' do nothing for a local import
findings.fix: Offer 'Show in Finder' / 'Show in folder' only for an existing file:// source, and reveal rather than open it. Hide the button for local:// sources. Remove 'Open manager', which navigates to the screen it is already on.

findings.title: Search/RAG Sources toggles take 3 rows each and push the answer below the fold at 100x30
findings.fix: Show the Sources toggles on one row in a reflowing grid. When results arrive, reveal the Answer heading, or keep the focused query at the top (the TASK-32751 contract).

findings.title: Search/RAG silently keeps the previous query's source toggles
findings.fix: Make the results count scope-aware: '2 results · Media only — Search all sources'. The rail box restores all sources.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the scope line is visible at 160 cols, and the zero-result copy points at the sources.

findings.title: An absolute file:// path takes the reader's first rows, and the reader is no wider than the list
findings.fix: Show the byline as '<basename> · local file' and put the path in Info. Give the Reader a ~72-cell prose floor before list_grows. Collapse Nav automatically, once, when a document loads.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the 4–5 rows come from a long harness path; typical paths take 2.

findings.title: Prompt 'Use in Console' turns {{notes}} into a literal {notes} with no warning, and leaves Instructions out (off by default) under a different name
findings.fix: Show an authoring hint when '{{name}}' appears. Add the dialog status 'No variables — {{notes}} will be inserted as {notes}'. Add an 'Instructions not applied' line and receipt. Title the dialog 'Use prompt in Console' when there are no variables. Do not collapse prompt inserts into the pasted-text chip.
findings.severity_note: The grammar is ruled by ADR-053. What is missing is the feedback.

findings.title: Replaying a Recent search under RAG Answer silently makes a paid call
findings.fix: In RAG mode a history row only fills the query and focuses Run ('Press Run to ask <model> again'). Later, store the mode per entry and mark paid ones 'RAG · paid'.
findings.severity_note: The verifier rated P3 because the cost line shows afterwards. Kept at P2: PRODUCT.md requires the cost to be visible before the action.

findings.title: Skill 'Customize' hides the built-in and leaves a copy the agent cannot run, without warning beforehand
findings.fix: Add an inline, trust-aware consequence line under Customize. After copying, open the copy in Trust or Edit. An overriding copy shows 'Replaces the built-in · Reset to built-in…'. Clear the stale › marker.

findings.title: Selecting an item in Media Trash keeps an unrelated live item in the Reader
findings.fix: Show a content excerpt on the selected Trash row. Change the identity line to 'Still showing <title> from Media · r restore to read'.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: this follows a task-31635 ruling, the item is labelled 'not in Trash', and Delete forever names the trashed row.

findings.title: Batch import has no cancel, and Enter imports while the footer still says 'check this path'
findings.fix: Resync the footer on every path keystroke. The first Enter checks and shows the forecast; the second imports. Add 'Cancel remaining (N)' to local batch rows.

findings.title: The Conversations reader stacks ~19 rows of chrome above the first message; at 80x24 no message is visible
findings.fix: Open Find on demand (ctrl+f). Use a one-line status. Put the actions in a wrapping grid. Cut the link-on-use reason to one line. Drop the 'Conversation reader' heading. Target: the first message at or above pane row 8 at 120x36.

findings.title: The Prompts list gets half the pane; the other half is blank
findings.fix: Add classes='library-source-pager' to #library-prompts-pager (library_prompts_canvas.py:1082), as Skills and Media do.

findings.title: The first import downloads an embedding model without saying so, and a Hugging Face warning is painted over the nav bar
findings.fix: In protect_file_descriptors, bind stdout/stderr to an fd-backed devnull when Textual's capture has no fd (Utils/fd_protection.py:151). Use TextualHandler(stderr=False) once the app is mounted. Show 'Preparing search index — one-time model download' on the queue row.
findings.severity_note: Raised: undisclosed network egress in a local-first product (PRODUCT.md principles 2 and 8).

findings.title: 'Keep for later' is split across Media Read later, Collections Reading and Home; Home's count lands on the wrong store; the Quick Capture note box has no label
findings.fix: Give the box the placeholder 'Note (optional)'. The Read later confirmation names Media ▸ Sets ▸ Review read-later (N), and that button shows the count. Fix Home's deep link (task-32910). Add a cross-reference line to the Collections empty state.
findings.severity_note: Raised: the verifier found that Home's 'Read-it-later: 2 items' opens a different store showing a different item.

findings.title: A fully successful import still offers 'Retry this batch' and the footer 'r retry'
findings.fix: Make the label depend on the outcome: 'Retry this batch' only when rows failed or were skipped, otherwise 'Import again with these settings…' and 'r import again'. Change the button, binding and chip together.

findings.title: Help and empty states never say what Library, Prompts or Skills are
findings.fix: Add a one-sentence 'What this is' per surface via WorkbenchHelpState.notes. Define a prompt in the Prompts empty state. Change 'invocable: user & agent' to 'Can be run by: you or the agent'. Show the trust banner only when user-added skills exist.

findings.title: Restore and archive reset 'updated' to now and reorder Newest and the landing
findings.fix: Sort and age conversations by their last message time. Widen task-32307 to keep pre-trash recency on restore. Leave the last_modified/ADR-147 stamp untouched.

findings.title: Clearing the Media filter also resets sort and type chosen while filtered
findings.fix: On clear, rebuild the scope from the applied scope with query='' (keeping sort and type). Use the snapshot only to restore the selection.
findings.severity_note: The toolbar 'Clear filter' button has the same bug.

findings.title: Media 'Use in Console' is always refused ('Copy or link this media into workspace workspace-default…') with no control that fixes it, while Search evidence stages the same item
findings.fix: Port link-on-use to _open_selected_media_handoff (library_screen.py:35519): link the item to the active workspace, stage it, and show 'Linked to Local Default · staged in Console · Undo link'. Show the display name, not the raw id (eligibility.py:79). Route Search 'u' through the same gate.
findings.severity_note: Every media item is affected, not just imports. The refused button is styled as enabled.

findings.title: Reader and note can never be on screen together; a rail switch throws away the reading position and closes a newly created note; Media has no 'take note' key
findings.fix: (1) Keep a saved note session across rail switches (drop the session_blank_id gate once content is saved). (2) Keep the open media id, tab and scroll across rail presses, and focus its row. (3) Fix the retained-editor render that shows a false 'changed elsewhere' conflict. (4) Add 'Take note' (n) to the Media reader. A split view needs an ADR-086 amendment (Q4).
findings.severity_note: Notes opened from the list do survive a switch; Blank-created notes do not. The verifier found a separate false-conflict render on the retained path.

findings.title: No way to quote a passage into a note with a link back to its source
findings.fix: Add 'Quote to note…' on highlight cards and a Reader selection key, inserting '> quote — [title](media://id)'. Render media:// in Preview. Show 'Notes citing this item' in media Info. Do not rebind Ctrl+C.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: copy, paste and a hand-typed citation work.

findings.title: Kept AI answers lose their provenance (no question, source or model; UUID keywords nobody can search); RAG Answers cannot be saved
findings.fix: Add a provenance footer to captured answers (question, conversation title, date, model, Sources with links). Info shows 'From conversation: <title> · Open'. Add 'Save answer as note' to RAG Answer. Make the provenance keywords searchable.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the conversation still exists, so provenance can be rebuilt by hand.

findings.title: Study hand-off dead-ends: a whole-Library 'ready' snapshot, clipped Dashboard/Flashcards controls, server-only generation, and creating or selecting a deck crashes the app
findings.fix: Crash first: drop **self._scope_arguments() from the list_flashcards call (UI/Study_Modules/flashcards_handler.py:649), or add those params to StudyScopeService.list_flashcards. Then set height:auto on the dashboard columns row, .study-dashboard-column and .card-editor. Use honest local-mode handoff copy ('Generating a pack from sources needs a tldw server'). Show the true scope instead of '… and 132 more'.
findings.severity_note: Escalated to P0 by the verifier: an unhandled TypeError exits the app (2/2). The crash is in Study code, on the Library→Study path.

findings.title: A second 'Use in Console' silently replaces the first staged note
findings.fix: Make stage_console_staged_evidence additive (merge, dedupe, renumber, cap 20), built on 33620.7's per-session keying. Status: 'Added to Console · 2 sources staged'. Add 'c use selected in Console' to Notes select mode.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the strip shows the true single source. The overwrite happens in Console's runtime, not the hand-off slot.

findings.title: Closing F1 or any modal drops keyboard focus on the landing, the Notes navigator (including a just-shown Undo), Conversations and Skills
findings.fix: In on_screen_suspend, record whether an overlay was pushed. On that resume, skip _refresh_library_visit_surfaces and the Notes canvas recompose. The landing restore searches the landing canvas. Add Pilot tests that F1/Esc keeps focus on each surface.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the note editor, Media and the rail keep focus; 9 Tabs back to Undo.

findings.title: Keys typed within ~0.15 s of submitting the Notes filter fire screen shortcuts: 'i' opens Import media, 'n' creates a stray note
findings.fix: Keep the filter Input mounted and sync only the results. Swallow single-letter accelerators while the Notes canvas is mid-recompose or a then= refocus is pending (event-driven, not timers, per ADR-104).
findings.severity_note: Narrow timing window; the stray import needs a real path, so 'one more Enter imports' was overstated.

findings.title: F6 never enters the Export or Search/RAG canvas, and entry focus stays on the rail
findings.fix: Add Export and Search/RAG F6 targets (library-export-name/destination, library-rag-query-input/run). _resolve_focus_target falls back to the pane's first visible focusable descendant. Entry focus lands in the canvas at every width. Contract test per rail row.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: Shift+Tab reaches 'Choose destination…' in 1–3 presses, so this is not a keyboard trap.

findings.title: Keyboard input can stop entirely after a destination switch (focus lands on a widget being removed) until a mouse click
findings.fix: BaseAppScreen.set_focus refuses detached or pruning widgets. The list-entry retry skips pruning candidates and counts only attached focus as landed. An app-level guard refocuses when screen.focused is detached. Add a race Pilot test.
findings.severity_note: The full hang did not reproduce in 20 attempts. The mechanism (7 focus writes to widgets being removed) was proven by instrumentation and a minimal repro.

findings.title: Escape means different things per destination; the advertised 'esc focus rail' does nothing when the rail is collapsed
findings.fix: One rule: Escape from a list only moves focus, to Search Library… when Nav is open, or to the Nav grip (chip 'esc focus Nav grip') when it is collapsed. Esc leaves Media select. Esc in a filter keeps the draft. Put the Escape ladder in F1.

findings.title: Active mode is invisible on Edit/Preview/Info, the 'Library notes | Folder files' strip and Read/Info; the active Skills tab looks disabled
findings.fix: Prefix the active option of every mode or segment strip with '✓ ' (pad the others). Rename Skills' '-active' (Textual's press-flash class) to 'is-active' and give it a real style.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: the content of each mode differs a lot, so users can tell where they are.

findings.title: Arrival focus and Tab order do not follow the screen: palette arrival focuses '⌃1 Home' (13 nav stops), Notes entry focuses the Nav grip
findings.fix: On a real arrival (not a modal pop), focus the destination's entry target from its list-arrived event, never the Nav grip. Make the Notes tree a single Tab stop with arrows inside.
findings.severity_note: Corrected cause: the strip already comes before the grid in the DOM.

findings.title: Six focus-indicator dialects: a one-cell underline, tints of 1.2–1.6:1, Skills rows without the █ bar, an amber Reader border against blue elsewhere
findings.fix: Use two dialects: a thick left edge for rows (extend task-31983 to Skills and Collections) and a ┃label┃ outline for 1-row buttons. The Reader uses $ds-action-focus. Scroll containers that are not the sole target are not focusable. Generalise the TASK-32613 stop-enumeration test.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: every stop changes something visible, so WCAG 2.4.7 is met.

findings.title: Footer and F1 disagree; F1 has a key-less '- : typing in field' row and no 'how it works'; Search/RAG advertises an inert 'o open evidence'
findings.fix: F1 reads the footer tuple that was actually registered. Drop key-less rows and expand 'after esc:' into a group. Gate 'o' through check_action. Use one predicate for Conversations 'c', and refresh the footer when Conversations arrives. Add a 'How Notes works' block.

findings.title: At 80 columns the Media reader's mode and action rows are cut mid-word ('Highligh', 'M'), so Info and More are off-screen
findings.fix: Mark the active mode with '✓ ' instead of ' (selected)', and wrap the toolbar instead of clipping it. Add an ellipsis plus tooltip on single-line Library labels. 80x24 label census test.
findings.severity_note: The nav-bar cuts in the evidence are invisible clip-ghosts by design (task-3200), so no action there.

findings.title: A vetoed nav-bar switch is silent, highlights the wrong destination, and swallows the retry click
findings.fix: In the app_navigation.py veto branch, call restore_active(current route) and notify the screen's veto message. LibraryScreen.flush_pending_work notifies validation vetoes with the field and reason.
findings.severity_note: Escalated: after fixing the title, clicking ⌃2 Console again does nothing (already-active guard), so the button looks broken.

findings.title: A deleted note stays staged in Console as 'Ready'; the send goes ahead without it and says nothing
findings.fix: When authorization drops staged references, block or show a notice at send: 'Trip planning: Lisbon was deleted — not sent · Remove · Restore'. Clear the reference. Revalidate the strip when entering Console.
findings.severity_note: Triage assumed the deleted text is sent; the live check refuted that (it is silently dropped).

findings.title: After a send, Console contradicts itself about staged sources, and follow-ups (even in a new tab) go out ungrounded with a log-only error
findings.fix: Append the Library-origin repro to 33620.7 and 33621.20. Release the consumed launch on the first-send path. Give the strip and the counts one source of truth. Log type(exc).__name__ (no traceback) at console_chat_controller.py:24676.
findings.severity_note: Raised to match the owning tasks, and because a new conversation also sends ungrounded while still showing the note as staged.

findings.title: Console 'Search Library' modal: typing goes nowhere, 'Staged' is shown before results exist, a jargon send-block, results re-stage after Un-stage
findings.fix: Set AUTO_FOCUS='#console-rag-settings-query'. Show 'Searching Library… · the first search loads the model' with Cancel, and let Send wait. Use plain block copy. Add a generation fence so Un-stage or Cancel drops late results (consider splitting this part out as P1).

findings.title: The landing's only 'Import…' goes to Media import, with no pointer to importing notes
findings.fix: Add a line to the Import media canvas: 'Markdown or Obsidian notes? Notes ▸ Add from files… keeps them editable' (as an action). Offer 'Import as notes / as media' when the selection is mostly .md. Make the landing tooltip honest.

findings.title: A relaunch drops the working context (staged sources, open note, filter, expanded folders)
findings.fix: Amend ADR-033 for an ids-only resume pointer (route, note id, expanded folders) that feeds the landing Continue slot. Never persist staged sources or filter text.
findings.severity_note: Lowered: memory-only state is ADR-033 by design, and 'From your Library' already lists the newest note.

findings.title: Unexplained chrome: an 'Agent_Lessons' folder with no gloss once notes exist, and literal '[ ]' task boxes in Preview
findings.fix: Always gloss Agent_Lessons (not only in an empty library) and add a '(empty — …)' child. Preview maps task items to ☐/☑ (read-only, with a legend line). Grips stay as ADR-086 specifies.

findings.title: Internal vocabulary and raw exceptions on screen ('rail', 'placement', 'owner review', 'lane', 'Persisted source', 'PermissionError'); the export failure is shown three times
findings.fix: Use one name, 'Navigation' (footer 'esc focus navigation'). Rename to 'Folders' and 'Remove from folder'. Change the alarm to '! Sync folder inactive · open Manage sync folders'. Add a shared OSError-to-sentence helper. Show one message, not three. Add a copy-lint denylist test.
findings.severity_note: '! Needs owner review' alone would merit P2 if split out.

findings.title: Polish: a toast covers its own Save/Discard buttons, receipts never name where deleted notes went, 'back to hub', no Study help labels
findings.fix: Receipt: '✓ deleted · <title> · in Recently deleted' (keep it, per ADR-055). Change 'back to hub' to 'back to Library' and add Study help labels. Dock toasts away from action rows. Use 'Next: Write the body below the title.' when a title exists.
findings.severity_note: The 'stale Next: Start typing' sub-claim was refuted: it is conditional on an empty body.

findings.title: User Guide keyboard and label claims disagree with the live app (8 of 12 checked)
findings.fix: Rewrite the 8 sentences after the behaviour fixes land. Land 32589's drift gate. Give each behavioural claim an executable twin test at 80x24 and 120x36.

findings.title: The Items grip label goes stale across routes ('Items' painted on Notes, or 'Notes' on Media)
findings.fix: Add LibraryAdaptiveReaderPaneGrip.set_pane_label(), which syncs and calls refresh(). Mounted test.
findings.severity_note: Intermittent. The verifier caught it in the reverse direction.

findings.title: Select-mode and hand-off keys differ between Media and Notes (s/Space vs button/Enter; e only in Notes; c only in Media)
findings.fix: One select grammar on Media and Notes: s enters the mode, Space toggles (priority binding), e exports, Esc leaves. Gate with check_action and keep the footer 1:1 with bindings.
